training.objective: Per-codebook masked cross entropy, independently averaged over labels not equal to -100, then combined with normalized weights [8,8,6,6,4,4,2,2].
training.codec_policy: Higgs Audio V2 and its HuBERT semantic encoder are frozen.
training.raw_boundary: Mono waveform plus explicit sample rate; peak-normalized to 0.9 and encoded at 24 kHz.
training.preprocessed_boundary: Integer audio_tokens with shape [8, frames] and values in [0,1024).
training.corruption_policy: Prompt ratio [0,0.3], mask ratio [0,1], conditioning dropout 0.1, language probability 0.8, pinyin probability 0.3, instruction probability 1.0, instruction-only probability 0.5.

generation.algorithm: Iterative masked-token decoding with classifier-free guidance

limits: No numerical waveform-parity or quality claim is made without a reference-output audit.
Voice cloning requires an explicit reference transcript; native OmniVoice does not invoke an external ASR model.
External text normalization and silence-removal packages are outside the architecture boundary.
The native generator currently executes one utterance per call; checkpoint and training batches remain supported.
